name: Hand-painted texture
summary: Paint the colour, light, shadow and wear of a surface by hand into its texture, so the material reads with little help from the engine.
how: Paint light from above: lighter top edges and darker bottoms on each element.
Shift shadows toward cool hues and highlights toward warm hues.
Paint wear as bright strokes 2–4 px wide on edges.

origin.note: World of Warcraft makes hand-painted, diffuse-only textures the standard of its art team.

adoptions.via: Torchlight and League of Legends carry the hand-painted look to other studios and to mobile games.
